name: Build and Deploy Architecture Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install VuePress CLI
        run: npm i -g vuepress@next

      - name: Initialize VuePress project
        run: |
          # Create docs folder and install dependencies
          npx vuepress@next init docs --yes
          cd docs
          npm install

      - name: Create VuePress config
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/.vuepress
          cat > docs/.vuepress/config.js <<'EOF'
          module.exports = {
            title: 'BookWorm Architecture',
            description: 'Architecture documentation for BookWorm',
            themeConfig: {
              nav: [
                { text: 'Architecture', link: '/architecture/01 - Introduction and Goals.md' }
              ],
              sidebar: [
                {
                  title: 'Architecture',
                  collapsable: false,
                  children: [
                    '/architecture/01 - Introduction and Goals.md',
                    '/architecture/02 - Constraints.md',
                    '/architecture/03 - Context and Scope.md',
                    '/architecture/04 - Solution Strategy.md',
                    '/architecture/05 - Building Block View.md',
                    '/architecture/06 - Runtime View.md',
                    '/architecture/07 - Deployment View.md',
                    '/architecture/08 - Cross-cutting Concepts.md',
                    '/architecture/09 - Architecture Decisions.md',
                    '/architecture/10 - Quality Requirements.md',
                    '/architecture/11 - Risks and Technical Debt.md',
                    '/architecture/12 - Glossary.md'
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
          };
          EOF

      - name: Clone arc42 template
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/arc42/arc42-template.git arc42-template
          mkdir -p docs/architecture
          cp -r arc42-template/docs/* docs/architecture/

      - name: Rename arc42 markdown files
        run: |
          cd docs/architecture
          mv "01-introduction-and-goals.md" "01 - Introduction and Goals.md"
          mv "02-constraints.md" "02 - Constraints.md"
          mv "03-context-and-scope.md" "03 - Context and Scope.md"
          mv "04-solution-strategy.md" "04 - Solution Strategy.md"
          mv "05-building-block-view.md" "05 - Building Block View.md"
          mv "06-runtime-view.md" "06 - Runtime View.md"
          mv "07-deployment-view.md" "07 - Deployment View.md"
          mv "08-cross-cutting-concepts.md" "08 - Cross-cutting Concepts.md"
          mv "09-architecture-decisions.md" "09 - Architecture Decisions.md"
          mv "10-quality-requirements.md" "10 - Quality Requirements.md"
          mv "11-risks-and-technical-debt.md" "11 - Risks and Technical Debt.md"
          mv "12-glossary.md" "12 - Glossary.md"

      - name: Create package.json with docs scripts
        run: |
          cat > package.json <<'EOF'
          {
            "name": "bookworm-docs",
            "private": true,
            "scripts": {
              "docs:dev": "vuepress dev docs",
              "docs:build": "vuepress build docs"
            },
            "devDependencies": {
              "vuepress": "^1.9.7"
            }
          }
          EOF

      - name: Commit and push documentation changes
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add .
          # Commit only if there are changes
          if ! git
